title: Participatory Action Research
teaser: We work with community members and stakeholders to identify local health problems, design investigations and put practical solutions into action.
body:
How we work

Every project starts with the community. Residents help define the question, collect the data and decide what to do with the findings.

  • Joint problem identification
  • Community-led data collection
  • Shared review of results

Impact

Findings go back to the people who produced them, within weeks, not months.

title: Community Nutrition Clinics
teaser: Monthly clinics that screen children for malnutrition and teach families low-cost, locally available meal planning.
body:
Run by trained village health teams, each clinic offers screening, counselling and referral in one visit.

  1. Growth monitoring
  2. Cooking demonstrations
  3. Referral to health centres where needed
